additionalProperties.value: Opens named resource via FileSystemRead, reads through its wrapper-handling routine, allocates 0x25800-byte output, invokes JpegDecoder, then blits with stride0x280,width0x140,height0xf0,x0,y0. DrawLogo supplies UTF16 'appl'. Failure invokes display fill callback. Full replacement/repacking not yet implemented.
Publishes DrawJpeg protocol 2bfd4382-cdb3-4867-b5bd-6f446696cc6b; slot0 is DrawJpeg_DrawNamedFirmwareResource.
